vqa_items.state: Does the image state the full course identity as "Fly Fishing Fundamentals: From Casting to Catching", "PE-087", and "Spring 2026"?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all three identity elements are present exactly or with harmless punctuation differences, and no competing course title or code appears.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if PE-087 and Spring 2026 are correct but the title is shortened without changing the course identity, or if the full title is present but one minor term label is omitted.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the title identifies a different course, PE-087 is absent or wrong, Spring 2026 is contradicted, or two or more identity elements are missing.

vqa_items.state: Does the image give the reconciled course run as March 24-April 23, 2026, exactly five sessions, and 10 total scheduled instruction hours?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the start date, updated end date, five-session count, and derived 10-hour total are all present and mutually consistent.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if the date range and session count are correct but the 10-hour total is omitted, or if all four facts are present with only the year implied by an otherwise correct Spring 2026 identity.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if April 21 is used as the end date, the count or hour total is wrong, or two or more required facts are missing.

vqa_items.state: Does the image state the indoor foundation sessions as Tuesday March 24, Tuesday March 31, and Tuesday April 7, from 5:30 PM to 7:30 PM?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all three dates, the Tuesday weekday pattern, and both time endpoints are correct with no conflicting recurrence label.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if all three dates and the 5:30 PM-7:30 PM time are correct but the weekday is omitted, or if exactly one date is missing while the remaining sequence is not contradicted.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the image labels the indoor sessions as Mondays or another wrong weekday, uses a wrong time, confuses the stage with outdoor sessions, or omits two or more dates.

vqa_items.state: Does the image identify the indoor meeting place as Garrett Information Enterprise Center (GIEC), Room 111, 687 Mosser Road, McHenry?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the expanded facility or GIEC plus Garrett Information Enterprise Center context, Room 111, 687 Mosser Road, and McHenry are all supplied without a conflicting campus location.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if the facility and Room 111 are correct but exactly one of the street address or McHenry is omitted, with no wrong location stated.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if only "GIEC Room 111" is shown without both public location details, if the room or facility is wrong, or if another campus or outreach center is presented.

vqa_items.state: Does the image state the outdoor practice sessions as Tuesday April 14 and Thursday April 23, from 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM, and mark them weather dependent?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if both dates, the Tuesday/Thursday weekday sequence, both time endpoints, and the weather-dependent condition are all correct.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if both updated dates, time, and weather condition are correct but weekdays are omitted, or if only one weekday is omitted while no wrong weekday is stated.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if April 21 appears as current, both sessions are labeled Monday or Tuesday, the time is wrong, weather dependence is absent together with another omission, or the stage is confused with indoor sessions.

vqa_items.state: Does the image identify the final two sessions as the outdoor stage at Deep Creek Lake State Park Discovery Center in McHenry?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the image ties sessions four and five or the final two sessions to the full Discovery Center meeting place and McHenry.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if the Discovery Center is correct and clearly tied to the outdoor stage but either the final-two-session relationship or McHenry is omitted.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the outdoor site is missing, replaced by McH, CARC, Herrington Manor, GIEC, or another location, or is attached to the wrong stage.

vqa_items.state: Does the image state the current fee as $95, the registration deadline as March 19, 2026, the exact URL garrettcollege.edu/cewd/register, and that registration is first-come, first-served?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all four public registration facts are correct and no stale fee, deadline, or alternate URL is presented.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if the fee, deadline, and exact URL are correct but the first-come, first-served basis is omitted, or if exactly one minor label such as the year is implied by Spring 2026.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if $89, $99, $105, March 17, March 18, March 21, or a different URL is presented as current, or if two or more required facts are missing.

vqa_items.state: Does the image name Rita Lewis as instructor, welcome both first-time fly fishers and people refining existing skills, and summarize the course as hands-on instruction progressing from essentials toward experienced techniques?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the instructor, both audience groups, the hands-on format, and the basics-to-experienced-techniques progression are all represented without copying or contradicting the catalog.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if Rita Lewis and both audience groups are correct but the summary omits either the hands-on format or the skill progression, or if the summary is correct but only one audience group is stated.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the instructor is wrong or absent, no suitable audience is identifiable, the course summary describes a different course, or two or more required ideas are missing.

vqa_items.state: Does the image contain exactly three learning takeaways in the order essential gear, rod setup and knots, then casting?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if there are exactly three takeaways and the gear-to-setup/knots-to-casting order is unambiguous, with no extra fourth outcome.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if exactly three correct categories are present but one pair is out of order, or if the order is correct but one category is phrased too generically to confirm fully.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if the count is not three, two or more categories are missing, unsupported outcomes replace a required category, or the progression cannot be determined.

vqa_items.state: Do the three learning takeaways collectively mention rods, fly lines, and reels; fly-rod parts and assembly; essential knots or gear assembly; and casting accuracy and distance?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all four catalog-grounded detail groups are represented across the three takeaways and none is replaced by unrelated content.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if exactly one detail group is incomplete or generalized while the other three are specific and correct.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if two or more detail groups are missing, if entomology or another optional highlight displaces required content, or if unsupported outcomes are added as substitutes.

vqa_items.state: Does the image state that loaner rods are available, participants should bring weather-ready layers and a valid Maryland fishing license for outdoor sessions, and weather updates are available at 301-387-3198?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if all three preparation requirements plus the exact weather-line number are present and correctly tied to outdoor participation or weather updates.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if the three preparation requirements are all correct but the weather-line number is omitted, or if exactly one preparation element is omitted while the remaining information has no conflict.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if participants are told they must bring their own rod, the license is not identified as Maryland, the phone number is wrong, or two or more required elements are missing.

vqa_items.state: Does the image state that withdrawal before the registration deadline receives a full refund and that no refund is available after the second class session, while excluding stale alternatives, another course, the instructor biography, registrar audit content, and general office contacts?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if both refund rules are correct and none of the listed stale, unrelated, biographical, audit, or general-contact material is published.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if both refund rules are correct but one harmless internal-looking label appears without exposing audit details, or if exactly one refund rule is omitted while all prohibited content remains absent.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 if either refund rule is contradicted, both are absent, or any stale value, neighboring-course content, biography excerpt, registrar ticket/state/note, staff-directory contact, or general registration-office phone/email is presented as public poster content.

vqa_items.state: As a promotional poster or recommendation flyer, does the image create an immediate focal offer, clearly prioritize featured items and supporting details, and combine persuasive visual energy with an elegant hierarchy, readable action information, and high-end poster craft, so that the core offer is understood instantly, the hero focal point is strong, the CTA is easy to find, and the overall composition feels publication-ready rather than generic or unfinished?

score_criteria.2: Score 2 only if the poster is exceptionally compelling and publication-ready: the core offer or recommendation is understood instantly; featured items, prices or details, and action information are clearly separated and easy to scan; the hero focal point is strong; typography, imagery, color, spacing, alignment, and margins are sophisticated and cohesive; promotional emphasis feels deliberate rather than loud or generic; and the whole composition is memorable, balanced, and nearly flawless. No cramped details, unclear CTA, generic sale-template look, weak imagery, malformed text, clipping, overlap, or visible cleanup issue is allowed. Any meaningful professional revision prevents 2.
score_criteria.1: Score 1 if the poster is understandable, usable, and visually decent or attractive, but it remains ordinary or has visible flaws such as a modest focal point, cramped details, uneven item emphasis, generic promotional styling, slightly weak CTA, or minor typography and spacing issues.
score_criteria.0: Score 0 even when the offer is technically present if the poster looks visibly poor, confusing, or unconvincing: focal hierarchy is weak, items or action details are hard to scan, imagery or typography is crude, composition is cluttered or empty, or the result requires substantial redesign. Blank, corrupted, severely unreadable, clipped, or broken posters are also 0.
